modalLead: Unraid and similar hosts can run Tailscale Docker hooks again — the container no longer starts with a fixed non-root USER that blocked root-only hook scripts.

items.text: Entrypoint drops privileges instead of fixed USER — container starts as root so host hooks can run; scripts/docker-entrypoint.sh chowns /app/data, then su-execs to nextdash. Set NEXTDASH_RUN_AS_ROOT=1 to keep root when required (Dockerfile).
